shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && find .agents -type f | head -100 && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md | head -100 && cat CLAUDE.md

cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore && find src -type f && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150 && echo ----- && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && for p in node_modules/@gravity-ui/*; do echo $p $(node -p "require('./$p/package.json').version"); done

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Switch Checkbox Select Avatar TextInput Modal ThemeProvider Flex

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Switch Checkbox Select TextInput Avatar Flex Text ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -120; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -50; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "tsc|vite"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && ls components | head -100; echo ----; for c in components/Button/Button.d.ts components/Switch/Switch.d.ts components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts; do echo "== $c"; cat $c 2>/dev/null | head -150; done; ls components/Button components/Switch components/Checkbox 2>/dev/null

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $B/components/types.d.ts | head -80; echo "== controls"; ls $B/components/controls; cat $B/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; echo "== Avatar"; cat $B/components/Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -60; echo "== Select"; sed -n 1,200p $B/components/Select/Select.d.ts | head -150

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $B/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -80; echo "== Select types"; grep -n "export interface SelectProps" -A 120 $B/components/Select/types.d.ts | grep -vE "^\S*-\s*\*|/\*\*" | head -120; echo "== Select option type"; grep -n "SelectOption\b" -A 12 $B/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -40

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; sed -n 1,27p $B/components/Select/types.d.ts; sed -n 76,120p $B/components/Select/types.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*\*"; echo "== AvatarImage"; cat $B/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls $B/components/Avatar; echo "== common"; cat $B/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; echo "== AvatarText/Icon"; cat $B/components/Avatar/AvatarText/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $B/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts; echo "== Select SelectOption/controls BaseInputControlProps"; grep -n "BaseInputControlProps" -A 25 $B/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -40; echo "== Text variants"; grep -rn "TextVariant\|export type TextProps" $B/components/Text/*.d.ts | head; echo "== Flex"; ls $B/components/layout; cat $B/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "== Card/Label"; cat $B/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; cat $B/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -20

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -rn "variant" $B/components/Text/*.d.ts | head -5; cat $B/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; echo "== Box"; sed -n 1,60p $B/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*\*\|/\*\*" ; echo "== Flex gap"; grep -n "gap" $B/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $B/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts | head; echo "== Checkbox/Switch ControlGroup-ish"; ls $B/components/controls/common; echo "== icons"; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -5; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i "person\|image\|camera\|upload\|pencil" | head;

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; sed -n 40,56p $B/components/Select/types.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*\*"; grep -n "onUpdate" $B/components/Select/types.d.ts; echo "== text variants"; grep -n "variant" $B/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "header\|body-1" $B/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -10; echo "== colorText"; grep -n "color" $B/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -10; echo "== spacing"; grep -n "p?:\|p:" $B/components/layout/spacing/spacing.d.ts | head -5; echo "== AvatarIcon"; cat $B/components/Avatar/AvatarIcon/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "== inputs size/view"; grep -n "InputControlView\|InputControlSize" $B/components/controls/types.d.ts | head -4

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && B=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "TEXT_COLORS" -A3 $B/components/Text/colorText/*.d.ts | head -8; grep -rn "export type Space " $B/components/layout/types.d.ts; grep -n "value" $B/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -5; npx tsc --version; npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC_BASELINE_OK

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; ls $B/hooks | head -50; cat $B/hooks/useFileInput/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; grep -n "BUTTON_VIEWS" -A2 $B/components/Button/constants.d.ts; grep -n "wrap" $B/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -3

B=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $B/hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.js | head -60; echo ==; ls $B/components/ControlLabel; grep -rn "label" $B/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.js | head -12; echo ==; grep -n "label" $B/components/Select/Select.js | head -8
npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
rm -rf dist && git status --short && wc -l src/*.ts src/*.tsx
